instruction: Please play this streaming video for me: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/bipbop_4x3/bipbop_4x3_variant.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using a different Apple HLS test stream (bipbop_4x3). Uses the existing is_vlc_playing metric with type='url' to verify VLC is streaming the specified URL. No custom functions needed.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing is_vlc_playing metric which checks VLC status XML for the streaming URL. The metric handles HLS streams by checking multiple XML paths for URL information.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: VLC is playing the specific HLS streaming URL
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) properly fetches VLC status via HTTP interface and saves to XML file
Metric (is_vlc_playing) correctly checks both playing state AND URL match using rule['type']=='url'
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric directly accesses rule['type'] and rule['url'], matching framework behavior where get_rule returns config['rules']
Metric has robust URL matching logic with multiple fallback strategies (lines 75-94 in vlc.py) for finding URL in XML
HLS stream support is explicitly handled (lines 105-125) including filename-only matching for streams
No postconfig needed as VLC HTTP status can be queried at any time
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies exactly what the instruction requires
